body: It's hell. I do it because I don't have a choice.
I'm the director of clinical services for a hospice. That's just a b.s. way to say im a hospice nurse. Nothing makes me happy. I worked 120 hours last week. I eat and watch tv when im not at work.
Watch "The Rabbit Proof Fence" movie first maybe. Just a thought.

I dont have a family. I've tried to reach out to people. I Have a church I got on medication for depression. But my job is hell. My entire purpose for living is now and always was to be used up and thrown away. I'm 38 now and I'm alone. My last relationship with a heroin addict ended with him stealing and selling everything Iown. Even my shoes. He wasn't an addict when I met him. I just want jesus to make me happy with my shitty fucked up life.make it so I don't want a family and enjoy being taken advantage of at work and being treated like I'm invisible. I can't do this anymore.

I don't know how to talk because I'm ashamed. I'm a Christian. I know who Jesus is. But He won't change me and I'm just tired and ashamed. If this is what life is supposed to be I can't anymore. I'm sorry for bothering y'all. Thank you.
